mechanics_text: A sentry gun, when launched, stays in its place and automatically fires upon any hostile targets in range until it or they are destroyed.
There can only be a maximum of 3 operational sentry guns in an area at any given time.
They can cause friendly fire, and are able to be healed by repair beams.
Players are also able to destroy them in order to place new ones at different locations.
Sentry guns despawn if you travel to another station's orbit or enter a station.
version_notes: Supernova DLC autonomous sentry gun (deploys in space, auto-fires on hostiles). Max 3 active at once. Supernova DLC.
